purpose: Qualify the existing printable trip checklist against the separately qualified completion lifecycle, and supply only a bounded owner-adoption patch if the composed consumer loses its declared eligibility fence.
scope: Isolated composition and native/browser receiving; original source/modules, public refs and deployed app unchanged. Any correction restricted to checklist eligibility/freshness spans and preserved as an exact receiving patch for existing owners.
expected: Admit the whole current saved collection with the completion owner's existing strict admission; invalid completion markers refuse before presenting or exporting a partial list.
A completed record is excluded from trip planning while ordinary open records retain exact reviewed fields, original attribution, identity and derived deadline.
A selection made while open must refuse download if that exact record becomes completed in a real second tab before the download gesture; no stale HTML artifact or storage mutation.
Reopen the same record through the completion owner's existing transition: it becomes selectable and downloadable again with original reviewed identity/details/deadline.
Only completed state => empty active trip list with clear ordinary refusal; no completion marker or saved data is deleted.
Completed unrelated records must not prevent an unchanged selected open record's valid download; exact literal Unicode/markup remains text.
receiving_limits: One focused model and actual checklist browser workflow; no standalone lifecycle or checklist matrix repetition.
Use actual source methods/storage and actual native completed download bytes; no provider/account operation or live saved data.
Do not infer broader PR20/main composition, deployment or cross-tab atomic transaction.
